gloss: to rearrange; to reorder; to sort

definitions.gloss: to rearrange; to reorder; to sort
definitions.explanation: To change the order or arrangement of items, putting them in a different sequence or configuration.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}をあいうえお{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}べ{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I rearranged the names in alphabetical order.

examples.japanese: {家具|かぐ}を{並|なら}べ{替|か}えて{部屋|へや}の{模様替|もようが}えをした。
examples.english: I rearranged the furniture and redecorated the room.

examples.japanese: {優先度|ゆうせんど}の{高|たか}い{順|じゅん}にタスクを{並|なら}べ{替|か}えて、{効率|こうりつ}よく{仕事|しごと}を{進|すす}めよう。
examples.english: Let's rearrange the tasks in order of priority and work efficiently.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {並|なら}べる (to line up, to arrange) + {替|か}える (to change, to replace). The combination means to change the existing arrangement into a new one. Very common in both physical contexts (rearranging objects) and digital contexts (sorting lists, reordering data).

This is an ichidan verb that conjugates like {替|か}える.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順番|じゅんばん}を{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to change the order
- あいうえお{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to sort in Japanese alphabetical order
- {日付|ひづけ}{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to sort by date
- {大|おお}きさ{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to sort by size

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {並|なら}べる: to line up; to arrange — placing items in order, without the nuance of rearranging
- {整理|せいり}する: to organize; to tidy — broader, includes discarding and categorizing
- ソートする: to sort — loanword used mainly in computing and data contexts
